title: Double Spoiler ~ Touhou Bunkachou - Bell of Avīci ~ Infinite Nightmare
description:
The final stages' theme from Double Spoiler.

It's a tense song with a lot of buildup and repetition, to really match the infinite nightmare that is playing scene 10-4 as Hatate. Probably best suited for long grind levels that you keep wanting to persevere at.

[13 April 2025] UPDATE: Changed a snare instrument.
